word: And I would walk the seven miles across town every Sunday night to get one good meal a week at the Hare Krishna temple.
meaning: 我每個星期天晚上都會走七英里穿越整個城鎮，去黑爾·克里希納神廟吃一頓好飯——一週只有那一頓。
example: Every Sunday he walked a long distance to the temple just to eat one decent meal.
hint:
中文解釋：用具體的距離和頻率，傳達退學生活的艱辛，也帶著一絲幽默。
1) seven miles (n.): 七英里（約11公里）；syn: a long distance; ant: a short walk
2) Hare Krishna (n.): 黑爾·克里希納（印度教派，提供免費餐食）；syn: temple; ant: (n/a)
pronunciation: Long sentence: WALK the SEV-en MILES | a-CROSS TOWN | ev-ery SUN-day NIGHT | Hare KRISH-na TEM-ple.

example: Despite the hardship, he genuinely enjoyed that simple lifestyle.
hint:
中文解釋：短短三個字，卻強而有力——他不是在抱怨，而是真心享受那段窮困卻自由的日子。
1) loved (v.): 喜愛；syn: enjoyed; ant: hated
2) it (pron.): 指代前面描述的那段艱苦生活；syn: that life; ant: (n/a)
pronunciation: Warm, emphatic: I LOVED it. (stress LOVED, brief and genuine)

word: And much of what I stumbled into, by following my curiosity and intuition, turned out to be priceless later on.
meaning: 而我憑著好奇心和直覺所偶然涉足的許多事，後來都證明是無比珍貴的。
example: Many things he discovered by chance and curiosity became incredibly valuable in the future.
hint:
中文解釋：核心主題句——隨興追隨好奇心，看似漫無目的，卻帶來意想不到的價值。
1) stumbled into (phr.): 偶然涉足、無意間遇到；syn: accidentally discovered; ant: planned carefully
2) priceless (adj.): 無價的；syn: invaluable; ant: worthless
pronunciation: Building: STUM-bled IN-to | cur-I-os-i-ty and in-TU-i-tion | PRICE-less LA-ter ON.

word: Let me give you one example.
example: He transitions to a specific story to illustrate his point.
hint:
中文解釋：演講技巧——簡短的過渡句，吸引聽眾注意，引出接下來的書法故事。
1) let me (phr.): 讓我（邀請式口吻）；syn: allow me to; ant: (n/a)
2) example (n.): 例子、示範；syn: illustration; ant: (n/a)
pronunciation: Inviting: Let me GIVE you ONE ex-AM-ple. (slight pause before 'one')

word: Reed College at that time offered perhaps the best calligraphy instruction in the country.
meaning: 里德學院當時提供的書法課，或許是全美國最好的。
example: At that time, Reed College was known for having excellent calligraphy classes.
hint:
中文解釋：引出書法課這個關鍵例子——看似偶然的選擇，卻改變了科技史。
1) calligraphy (n.): 書法；syn: hand lettering; ant: typing
2) instruction (n.): 教學、課程；syn: teaching; ant: self-study
pronunciation: Clear: REED COL-lege | the BEST cal-LIG-ra-phy in-STRUC-tion | in the COUN-try.

word: Throughout the campus, every poster, every label on every drawer, was beautifully hand-calligraphed.
meaning: 整個校園裡，每一張海報、每個抽屜上的每一個標籤，都有美麗的手寫書法字。
example: Every sign and label around the school was written in elegant handwriting.
hint:
中文解釋：用具體的視覺細節，讓聽眾感受到里德學院書法文化的深度與美感。
1) throughout (prep.): 遍及、在…各處；syn: all over; ant: nowhere in
2) hand-calligraphed (adj.): 手寫書法的；syn: handwritten artistically; ant: printed
pronunciation: Visual: through-OUT the CAM-pus | EV-ery POS-ter | EV-ery LA-bel | beau-ti-ful-ly HAND-cal-li-graphed.

word: Because I had dropped out, and didn't have to take the normal classes, I decided to take a calligraphy class to learn how to do this.
meaning: 因為我已經退學，不需要修正規的課程，我決定去旁聽書法課，學習如何做到這件事。
example: Free from mandatory courses, he chose to attend a calligraphy class out of pure interest.
hint:
中文解釋：退學帶來的自由讓他能選擇自己真正想學的東西，這是關鍵轉折。
1) had dropped out (v.): 已退學；syn: had quit school; ant: had stayed enrolled
2) normal classes (n.): 正規課程、必修課；syn: required courses; ant: elective courses
pronunciation: Because I had DROPPED OUT | did-n't HAVE to TAKE | I de-CI-ded | cal-LIG-ra-phy CLASS.

word: I learned about serif and sans-serif typefaces, about varying the amount of space between different letter combinations, about what makes great typography great.
meaning: 我學到了有襯線字體和無襯線字體的知識，學到不同字母組合之間間距的調整，學到偉大字體排版的精髓所在。
example: He discovered the details of font design, letter spacing, and what makes printed text look beautiful.
hint:
中文解釋：列舉出他學到的具體書法知識——這些看似無用的知識，後來成為 Mac 的基礎。
1) serif (n.): 有襯線字體（如 Times）；syn: traditional typeface; ant: sans-serif
2) typography (n.): 字體排版；syn: type design; ant: plain text
pronunciation: List rhythm: SER-if and SANS-ser-if | VAR-y-ing the SPACE | what makes GREAT ty-POG-ra-phy GREAT.
